title_original: Check Point Supports OpenAI’s Call for Collective Action on Cyber Defense
description: AI is reshaping cybersecurity at extraordinary speed. Check Point Research is already uncovering AI-powered attacks in the wild, revealing how threat actors are operating at greater scale and with growing sophistication. As these capabilities advance, cyber defense must advance just as quickly. That is why Check Point is proud to support OpenAI’s call for collective action on cyber defense, alongside organizations across the technology and cybersecurity ecosystem. We share the belief that meeting this challenge requires the industry to come together, expanding access to effective security tools, sharing intelligence and expertise, and helping organizations strengthen their defenses and resilience.
